title: AI-PAVE-Br: Leveraging Large Language Models for Enhanced Product Attribute Value Extraction through a Golden Set Approach
title_zh: AI-PAVE-Br：通过 Golden Set 方法利用大语言模型增强商品属性值抽取
abstract_en: The explosive growth and complexity of product data within the dynamic Brazilian e-commerce landscape demand robust and specialized methods for structured information extraction. Traditional approaches to Product Attribute Value Extraction (PAVE) often struggle with the linguistic nuances and sheer diversity of product descriptions in Portuguese. To address this critical gap, this paper introduces two major contributions. First, we present AI-PAVEBr, a specialized system engineered with Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform high-accuracy PAVE specifically for Brazilian e-commerce catalogs. Second, to facilitate reproducible research and provide a definitive benchmark, we introduce and share the Golden Set, a new, meticulously curated, and manually annotated dataset for PAVE in Portuguese. We detail the creation process and structure (Entity, Category, Subcategories) of this high-quality reference set. Our experiments conclusively show that AI-PAVE-Br, leveraging targeted prompt engineering, dramatically outperforms conventional Named Entity Recognition (NER) baselines. This work not only delivers a superior, scalable solution for a major non-English market but also enriches the NLP community with a valuable, publicly available resource for future PAVE research.
abstract_zh: 本文面向巴西电商场景中快速增长且复杂多样的葡萄牙语商品数据，研究 Product Attribute Value Extraction（PAVE，商品属性值抽取）问题。传统 PAVE 方法难以充分处理葡萄牙语商品描述中的语言细节与类目多样性。为此，论文提出两项贡献：其一是 AI-PAVE-Br，一个基于 Large Language Models（LLMs）的专用系统，用于在巴西电商目录中实现高精度 PAVE；其二是 Golden Set，一个经过人工精标、结构化设计并公开共享的葡萄牙语 PAVE 基准数据集，包含 Entity、Category、Subcategories 等层级信息。实验表明，AI-PAVE-Br 通过有针对性的 prompt engineering 显著优于传统 Named Entity Recognition（NER）基线，为非英语电商市场提供了可扩展的信息抽取方案，也为 NLP 社区提供了新的可复现实验资源。
key_points_zh: 提出 AI-PAVE-Br，面向巴西电商商品目录，利用 LLMs 执行葡萄牙语 Product Attribute Value Extraction（PAVE）。
构建并公开 Golden Set：一个人工精标的葡萄牙语 PAVE 数据集，支持 Entity、Category、Subcategories 等结构化标注。
通过 targeted prompt engineering，AI-PAVE-Br 在实验中显著优于传统 NER 基线方法。
论文强调非英语、尤其是葡萄牙语电商场景中的语言复杂性与商品描述多样性，并提供了可复现的评测基准。
该工作兼具应用价值与资源贡献，可推动未来面向电商属性抽取和多语言 NLP 的研究。

llm_assessment.comment: A useful applied LLM system and benchmark for extracting product attributes in a real e-commerce catalog setting.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项实用的LLM应用与基准，面向真实电商目录中的商品属性抽取。
